coordinate_transform.project_crs: Project-local approximate campus XY meters; X east, Y north, Z up

sources.provider: Purdue University official campus building footprint service
sources.measurement_method: Official feature polygon transformed with the repository's project-local conversion; polygon area and XY bounds computed from source ring.
sources.observation: The polygon represents the mapped venue grounds/envelope. It is not interpreted as a structural-wall outline or surveyed stage boundary.
sources.uncertainty: No source survey metadata establishes which physical edges the envelope follows.

sources.provider: Wikimedia Commons photo by Nowimnthing; image page and metadata
sources.source_date: Uploader states photo was taken 2006-06-21; Commons upload timestamp 2006-06-22
sources.crs: WGS 84 GPS coordinates (40.432306, -86.922861); image dimensions 2304 x 1536 pixels
sources.measurement_method: Camera location converted into project-local XY and compared with transformed GIS venue envelope. The photo metadata reports camera compass heading approximately 160 degrees; camera-to-envelope-center bearing is approximately 154.75 degrees, a 5.25-degree difference.
sources.observation: The view shows the open stage with a flaring canopy, tripod steel support, many suspension cables, rear acoustic reflector fins, front steps, and audience seating on a sloped lawn. The photographed audience approach is consistent with a stage front facing approximately 334.4 degrees (north-northwest) in campus azimuth.
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0; attribution required; share-alike terms apply.
sources.uncertainty: A single oblique photo supports feature identification and approximate viewing direction, not a surveyed stage center, roof dimensions, elevations, or exact internal placement. Embedded EXIF capture time reports 2004, conflicting with the uploader's 2006-06-21 date.

sources.measurement_method: Official facility description; no measurements taken.
sources.observation: Identifies Slayter as an outdoor amphitheater.
sources.uncertainty: The page does not provide a plan, dimensions, orientation, or elevation.

sources.measurement_method: Secondary published text; stage dimensions converted from feet to meters.
sources.observation: Reports stage dimensions of 56 ft front width, 34 ft rear width, and 46 ft depth, a flaring-horn plan, and a concrete roof suspended from a steel tripod.
sources.uncertainty: No original drawing or independent survey was located to confirm the secondary dimensions.

derived_geometry.height_status: Estimated canopy edge 7.7 m and steel tripod apex 15.5 m; no measured elevations.
